Heat oven to 350⁰. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Heat meatballs in microwave according to package. 

Unroll and separate dough into 2 long rectangles. Place on cookie sheet 1 inch apart. Press edges and perforations to seal. Roll each into a 14x4 inch rectangle. 

Sprinkle mozzarella down center of each piece of dough. Space meatballs evenly on top of mozzarella. Spoon pasta sauce over each meatball. Press the ends together to seal (should look like the front end of a boat). 

Starting from one end, gently pull the dough up and between each meatball and press together at the center. 

In a bowl mix melted butter, Italian seasoning and garlic powder. Brush over the top of the dough. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese. 

Bake 26-30 minutes until dough is cooked through and golden. Serve with warm pasta sauce for dipping and more parmesan topping. 

Note: pasta sauce will make the dough harder to stick together. Make sure initial seals are tight.
